title: PM25_Santiago: Spatiotemporal PM2.5 forecasting for inversion-dominated basins
description: Code and processed data for the paper by Parra & Astudillo on daily PM2.5 prediction for Santiago de Chile (target journal: Atmospheric Pollution Research). Implements XGBoost walk-forward forecasting at 1/3/7-day horizons benchmarked against ARIMA, Prophet and a persistence baseline (with Diebold-Mariano tests), Leave-One-Station-Out spatial interpolation (Regression Kriging), episode-transition-day analysis, conformal uncertainty calibration, and the cross-basin transfer replication in Salt Lake City. Includes data acquisition (Google Earth Engine, SINCA), feature engineering, modeling, and figure generation.
